newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's Yme oil output remains reduced.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Yme oil output remains reduced.

text.p: Production at the North Sea Yme oilfield remained at a reduced flow on Monday due to compressor problems at the platform, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Monday.

Output at the field and the nearby satellite Beta East was running at about 5,800 cubic metres per day, or 36,482 barrels per day (bpd), compared with a normal rate of 8,000 cubic metres (50,000 bpd), Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange said.
"We reduced flow about 10 days ago. Two compressors have broken down, which is causing problems for the reinjection of gas," Lange said.
"We are having to flare the gas at the moment."
Lange could not say how long production at Yme would remain reduced.
